# Omnimo vs Poe

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

Poe, from Quora, was one of the first apps to put many AI models in one place, and Omnimo does the same thing on a smaller scale. The difference is mostly breadth against simplicity.

## Side by side

|  | Omnimo | Poe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Made by | An independent developer | Quora |
| Models | GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax: from several makers, switchable mid-chat, plus Apple Intelligence on the device | models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, image and video generators, and over a million custom bots |
| Price (US) | Free; Omnimo Pro $6.99 a week (3-day trial), $9.99 a month, $39.99 a year (1-week trial) | Basic $4.99 a month or $49.99 a year, Plus $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year (in-app purchase list); usage is counted in points |
| Free to start | Unlimited Apple Intelligence on the device; a few messages a day with GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Flash; one image a day | Free download |
| On-device model | Apple Intelligence, free, unlimited and offline (iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 on a supported device) | Not in its listing |
| What the listing highlights | photos the model can see, documents read on the device, Ask Web with sources, image and video generation, your own assistants, voice, Siri and Shortcuts, a widget, 46 languages, no account | several bots in one chat to compare answers, custom bots you can build and share, web search, files, image and video generation |
| App Store rating | New: one rating on the US App Store when we checked | 4.7 from 53,800 ratings (US App Store, 25 November 2026) |

Omnimo: the app's App Store listing and its pricing (US). Poe: its App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, US storefront, read 25 November 2026. Prices in other countries differ.

## Where Poe is better

Poe has far more: models from many makers, image and video generators, and over a million custom bots, including ones you can build and share. You can bring several bots into one chat to compare answers. Its Basic plan starts at $4.99 a month, cheaper than Omnimo Pro.

## Where Omnimo is better

Omnimo is simpler: one list of models, a daily allowance instead of points, and Apple Intelligence free and offline on supported devices. Documents are read on your device, there is no account, and Siri and Shortcuts work on the device. Pro at $9.99 a month includes every model in the app.

## The honest verdict

**Choose Poe** if you want the widest choice of models and bots, or to build your own bots.

**Choose Omnimo** if you want a short list of leading models, a free on-device model and no account.

Both are free to try: [Poe on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1640745955) and [Omnimo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891). Omnimo is made by the team that writes this site, so weigh this page accordingly; we have tried to say where Poe wins.

## Questions

### Does Omnimo use points like Poe?

No. Omnimo gives a number of messages a day: a few on the free plan, hundreds on Pro. Flagship models count against a smaller daily allowance.

### Is Poe cheaper than Omnimo?

Poe Basic is $4.99 a month and Poe Plus $19.99 a month in the App Store's list (25 November 2026). Omnimo Pro is $9.99 a month, $6.99 a week or $39.99 a year in the US.

### Can I make my own bot in Omnimo?

You can make your own assistants, with a name, a purpose, an icon and instructions, and pick the tone of replies. They stay on your device; Omnimo has no public bot store like Poe.
